    Shift isomorphisms of the pair functors #

    For a pair (h, h') of half-words at v with signs s, !s, write num = h⁺ ∩ h'⁺ and den = h⁻ ∩ h'⁺ + h⁺ ∩ h'⁻; the pair functor is num / den. If h = a X starts with a direct letter a : v → u, then a induces an isomorphism from the functor of (a X, Y) at v to that of (X, a⁻¹ Y) at u (shift). We record isomorphisms without quotient types (FIso). The functor is symmetric in the two half-words.

    source
    structure BrickAccessibility.FIso {k : Type u_1} {X : Type u_2} [Field k] [AddCommGroup X] [Module k X] (φ : X →ₗ[k] X) (num₁ den₁ num₂ den₂ : Submodule k X) :
    Prop

    A linear map inducing an isomorphism num₁ / den₁ ≅ num₂ / den₂.

    • map_num : Submodule.map φ num₁ ≤ num₂
    • map_den : Submodule.map φ den₁ ≤ den₂
    • surj : num₂ ≤ Submodule.map φ num₁ ⊔ den₂
    • inj (x : X) : x ∈ num₁ → φ x ∈ den₂ → x ∈ den₁

      structure BrickAccessibility.IsoOnto {k : Type u_1} {X : Type u_2} {V : Type u_3} [Field k] [AddCommGroup X] [Module k X] [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V] (φ : V →ₗ[k] X) (num den : Submodule k X) :
      Prop

      φ induces an isomorphism V ≅ num / den.

      • mem (y : V) : φ y ∈ num
      • inj (y : V) : φ y ∈ den → y = 0
      • surj : num ≤ φ.range ⊔ den
